name: Bronzebeard the Elder
summary: During the Lunar Festival, travelers honor Bronzebeard the Elder beneath Ironforge. His greeting offers wisdom and a token of esteem. Across Khaz Modan, people revere their forebears and their long-lived heritage.

sections.title: Homage to the Mountain Clan
sections.body: During the Lunar Festival, spirits and venerable elders appear across Azeroth to share wisdom with travelers who honor the past. In Ironforge, Elder Bronzebeard carries the Bronzebeard clan’s stalwart resilience. He is quietly pleased when travelers come to pay their respects and the people honor the lineage of the old races.

sections.title: Tokens of Ancestral Esteem
sections.body: No great trial or perilous journey is needed. Travelers pause to greet Elder Bronzebeard and offer their good wishes. He returns the greeting with a Coin of Ancestry, a festival token recalling the living bond between the present and the generations who forged Khaz Modan from stone and fire.

faq.answer: Elder Bronzebeard is an ancestral dwarf honored during the Lunar Festival. In Ironforge’s subterranean stronghold, he greets visitors and celebrates their heritage.

faq.q: What does honoring Elder Bronzebeard signify?
faq.answer: Greeting Elder Bronzebeard honors the ancestors during the Lunar Festival. He commends travelers who remember the roots and ancient sacrifices of Azeroth’s early races.

faq.q: Where in Ironforge is Elder Bronzebeard found?
faq.answer: Elder Bronzebeard is found within Ironforge’s subterranean stronghold. Adventurers exploring the mountain city can reach him there.

faq.q: Can Horde players speak with Elder Bronzebeard?
faq.answer: Elder Bronzebeard acknowledges anyone who greets him. Horde travelers must brave Ironforge’s fortified depths and evade the dwarven guards to reach him.

faq.q: What reward does the elder bestow?
faq.answer: Elder Bronzebeard offers an ancestral blessing and a festival coin. Both are tokens of goodwill and respect for the ancient generations.

faq.q: Does this quest involve any combat?
faq.answer: No combat is needed to greet Elder Bronzebeard. The journey through hostile territory may still bring danger.

angles.text: As a dwarf, paying homage to Elder Bronzebeard brings you into communion with the noble ancestors who built your mountain kingdom from stone and iron.
Elder Bronzebeard lives peacefully in Ironforge and welcomes Alliance members who come to honor ancient traditions beneath the mountain.
As a member of the Horde, reaching Elder Bronzebeard means entering Ironforge’s fortified core. Stealth or daring can carry you there to offer a greeting.
